description: Header file defining interfaces, classes, and structures for message storage and metadata in a messaging system within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for event objects with serialization and data access methods.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class storing message metadata including type, category, and module.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects with enable, destroy, and metadata access methods.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata with timestamp information.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface for message storage with methods to push messages and check defaults.

classes.name: IStore::Tracing
classes.description: Extended info for tracing messages, including file, line, and class info.

classes.name: IStore::WarningReporting
classes.description: Extended info for warning reports, including callsign.

classes.name: IStore::OperationalStream
classes.description: Extended info for operational stream messages.

classes.name: IStore::Assert
classes.description: Extended info for assert messages, including process and callstack details.

methods.name: IStore::Set
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of IStore.
